name: retailpulse-dashboard-webapp
description: Complete Full-stack app monitoring dashboard example app. Self-hostable, Apache-2.0.

paragraphs: If you want a self-hosted monitoring dashboard without the vendor lock-in, RetailPulse Dashboard is ready to run. Built with Full-stack app and Apache-2.0-licensed, RetailPulse Dashboard ships complete — one clone, one install command. RetailPulse is a self-contained Gradio data/ML dashboard that opens straight to a clean, minimal UI with three distinct tabs: Overview (KPIs and summary charts), Data Explorer (filterable table), and Prediction/Analys…. Open RetailPulse Dashboard on cenius.ai to customise it without touching a line of RetailPulse Dashboard code.

▶ Open & edit in cenius.ai — one click to an editable workspace: describe changes in plain English, get an instant preview, one-click deploy and host. Modifications made on the platform come with full rebrand & relicense rights.
Local clone? See Quick start below. cenius.ai is the zero-setup path.
features: Overview tab with KPI cards and summary charts
Data Explorer tab with filters and read-only table
Prediction/Analysis tab with live local prediction
